children: to Mkango Magnetic Materials Limited, effective at the market open on September 23, 2026.

The rebrand marks the company's strategic pivot from early-stage raw material exploration to downstream rare earth supply chain operations, with a primary focus on magnet manufacturing and recycling technologies.

Mkango will continue trading under its current ticker symbol "MKA" across the TSX Venture Exchange and AIM and the website address remains unchanged, while updated securities identifiers, including CUSIP 60701M107 and ISIN CA60701M1077 take effect concurrently.

title: Mkango changes corporate name to Mkango Magnetic Materials, and retains ticker
